change_summary: Added a runtime-only cross-asset-gated macro runner. ETF proxies are included as sensors only; A+B signals are generated from the original base universe. Macro entry is unchanged from exp-20260425-005; only activation changes to `gold_risk_off_proxy AND NOT rates_positive`. No production code was promoted.

delta_metrics.note: The cross-asset gate is a mechanism improvement over static macro, but it still fails Gate 4 against the A+B baseline because mid_weak remains materially worse. It blocks late_strong completely and preserves part of old_thin, but it still admits two damaging mid_weak trades.

hypothesis: The full cross-asset proxy set may allow a macro gate that blocks late/mid macro losers while preserving old_thin macro winners. Test the strongest audit-derived state: GLD 20d return leads SPY and QQQ while SPY/QQQ are under pressure, and the TLT/IEF rates basket is not positive.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: gate blocks all macro trades and preserves A+B baseline
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: gate reduces but does not eliminate damaging macro exposure
market_regime_summary.old_thin: gate preserves part of the macro benefit but less than static macro

next_retry_requires: Do not promote this gate as-is
Do not keep sweeping tiny rates thresholds around avg(TLT,IEF) <= 0 without first identifying the two remaining mid_weak false positives
If macro continues, analyze the admitted mid_weak trades versus the retained old_thin trades for a new information source or execution/timing distinction
A credible next step is a trade-level false-positive audit, not another broad macro gate
notes: Single causal variable held: macro entry stayed unchanged; only the activation information source changed. Production strategy code was not changed.

parameters.date_inference_fix: initial run failed to trigger old_thin because feature close was rounded to 2 decimals; final run supports 2- and 4-decimal SPY close matching
parameters.gate_definition: GLD_20d > SPY_20d AND GLD_20d > QQQ_20d AND min(SPY_20d, QQQ_20d) < 0 AND avg(TLT_20d, IEF_20d) <= 0

rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability. The gate improves the static macro failure mode but does not make macro robust versus the A+B baseline: mid_weak EV regresses from 0.3924 to 0.2847, exceeding the allowed damage.
